bibl.title: A Group of Bronze, Egyptianizing ba-birds.
bibl.seg: Robert Steven Bianchi, A Group of Bronze, Egyptianizing ba-birds.
bibl.note: Collection Fondation Gandur pour l'Art, Genève, Inv. FGA-ARCH-RA-0199. Thymiaterion, or incense burner (bronze, 17.9 cm), Roman Imperial Period. The object consists of several separated cast and anciently joined elements: a human-headed bird; a cobra, with linear ornamentation; a flaring shaft to which is attached the profiled circular censor.
